title: Charge and size effects in π-ligand activation: an IR spectroscopic study of gold–acetylene complexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44304-44313
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06762F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
J. Reichegger, M. Knabl, M. Schmidt, A. M. Reider, M. Ončák, P. Scheier, O. V. Lushchikova
C2H2 behaves differently depending on the charge and size of gold clusters. Cations form coordination bonds, activating C2H2, whereas anions don't. The interaction weakens as size or ligand number grows.
